scope: Original unfamiliar melody production upgrade; generic dance-pop and percussive-pop benchmarks, no song audio or stored song melodies

verification.productionSmoke: passed: SQLite, producer status, built assets, SPA routing, source containment, project read API

features: Fresh-input pitch range, register, rhythmic density, qualified tempo evidence, syncopation, motion, energy and rest-defined phrases
production:auto follows existing genre; explicit dance-pop and percussive-pop can be requested through the existing producer
Reference titles select generic production traits only, without a reference lookup or any copied lead notes
Input-dependent harmony, economical chord voicing, register separation, lower competing density under busy leads and phrase-aware backing dynamics
Distinct original synthesized kick, snare, clap, closed/open hats, pluck and pad articulations
Dry centered lead and low end, bounded backing stereo, backing-only kick ducking and useful bass register
Exact source melody/contour binding, unchanged source timing and explicit instrument/layer restrictions
Inclusive 65–1400 Hz detector endpoints with bounded interpolation tolerance, rejecting tested out-of-range tones

nativeRenderRepeatability.explanation: Exact source events are required. Repeated identical native OfflineAudioContext renders varied by one PCM16 quantization step in a few samples; waveform comparison uses this measured bound. Production audio was not rounded to force matching hashes.

referenceStudy.use: High-level percussive keyboard texture and economical production context; generic implementation choices, not transcription
Production-first dance-pop context; generic implementation choices, not transcription

limits: This is a deterministic note-conditioned arrangement and synthesis upgrade, not training or verification of a universal learned audio generator.
Unknown melodies do not need recognition against a song library. Accuracy still depends on clear monophonic input within the supported range and 60-second capture limit.
Tempo and musical character are qualified evidence-based suggestions; an ambiguous or rubato phrase can correctly yield no confident BPM.
Synthetic pitch/timing and finite nonclipping PCM checks do not establish subjective polish, commercial mastering, or perfect human microphone transcription.
Full-mix pitch transcription is not used as an exact melody proof; decoded lead stems are tested separately.
Actual MusicGen inference and live external producer quality were not tested. No model weights or song audio were downloaded for this upgrade.
